name: nginx
description: The official NGINX Open Source repository.
one_liner: The software that quietly runs a huge share of the world's websites behind the scenes, serving pages fast and balancing traffic.

A hosting reseller builds managed nginx-and-SSL hosting packages aimed at local businesses who don't want to touch a server.
An agency bundles nginx-based caching and load-balancing tuning into its website care plans to justify a monthly maintenance retainer.
